_comment: Full-engine eval set (Phase 7). Runs through the real ChatEngine with mock product data. Frozen: never used for training (Phase 11 dataset builder excludes these questions). expect_tools = tools that must be called; expect_action = an action card that must be proposed (after = subset of the proposed state); expect_no_action = no card may be proposed; must_mention = case-insensitive substrings the answer must contain.
